purpose: Blind review of rendered official DOCX files. Document craft is reported separately from task accuracy.
review_unit: One rendered DOCX identified only by an opaque review ID.

criteria.question: Does every page render successfully without a blank, corrupt, or missing page?
Is all visible text and table content free from clipping or overflow beyond the page?
Are text, tables, headers, footers, and other elements free from incoherent overlap?
Is body text legible at normal page scale, with usable spacing and line length?
Are tables legible, with distinguishable headers, usable columns, and wrapped content that remains readable?
Do title, headings, labels, and body text create a consistent hierarchy that supports scanning?
Are page breaks, repeated headers, whitespace, and section transitions usable without material disruption?
Would the layout be practical to hand to a transaction professional for review without a broad formatting pass?

ratings.good: Every critical and non-critical criterion passes.
ratings.mixed: Every critical criterion passes, but one or more non-critical criteria fail. The document remains usable after local formatting revision.
ratings.poor: At least one critical criterion fails, or formatting defects are pervasive enough that the document is not practically reviewable.

blinding.id_algorithm: HMAC-SHA256(local_salt, protocol_id + '/' + model_key + '/' + trial_id), first 16 lowercase hex characters
blinding.procedure: Copy DOCX files and rendered page directories under opaque review IDs. Keep the ID mapping unavailable to the reviewer until every craft record is frozen.
